name: Channing "Stacks" Lorenzo
profileSummary: Mitchell LaValley is an American professional wrestler. As of March 2022, he is signed to WWE where he performs on the NXT brand under the ring name Channing "Stacks" Lorenzo, and is a member of the BirthRight stable. He is a former two-time NXT Tag Team Champion and a former one-time and final NXT Heritage Cup Champion. He also makes appearances in WWE's partner promotion Total Nonstop Action Wrestling (TNA), where he is a former one-time TNA International Champion.
